question: After safe manifest namespacing, how many family-result observations repeat the same edge, disagree on solve status, or switch winning configuration across source runs?
nonDuplication: ETT-024 proved all 911 rows resolve uniquely but deliberately did not pool them. This emits a source-preserving migration and measures the repeated-run selection problem before any boundary aggregation.

sampleSelection.rule: all 911 ETT-024-resolvable rows; retain every source observation with file/commit/budget metadata

primaryOutcome: unique edges, repeated edges, and solve-status conflict edges
stoppingRule: one lossless migration; no deduplication, preferred-run selection, family aggregation, or solving
escalationRule: define an explicit contemporaneous-run selection policy if repeated/conflicting edges exist; only a selected dataset may feed family-boundary-report
